name: Trainable classifiers
short_description: Machine-learning classifiers in Microsoft Purview that learn to recognize a kind of document, such as contracts or source code, from example documents, and can be used as conditions in DLP and labeling policies.

evidence.quote: That's what a trainable classifier does.
Trainable classifiers handle content that has no fixed format
PerView offers built-in pattern detectors, trainable classifiers, and custom information types
